model: Fixed-intercept, family-weighted ridge logistic additive score; no interactions or feature selection
formula: q(x)=sigmoid(logit(p_train)+sum_j beta_j*(x_j-mu_train_j)); mu and p_train use training groups only
objective: sum_i w_i*logloss(y_i,q_i) + lambda/2*sum_j beta_j^2; each training mechanism group has total weight one
intercept: Fixed to the unchanged Beta(1,1)-smoothed training-group prior; not optimized, so an empty/no-signal feature model exactly recovers the prior
parameter_rationale: One predeclared regularization strength on unscaled Boolean effects; not selected using these development results. Sensitivity and calibration remain untested.
constant_features: Drop training-constant columns, coefficient zero. Record test values not seen in training; these cannot supply learned evidence.
split: Reuse exactly the prior common cohort, source mechanism groups and per-fold train/test IDs. Two feature arms, three grouped folds, six additive fits. No in-sample deployment model.
admission: Reuse complete-eleven-feature gate for both arms; unknowns abstain without filling values. Real Java/JDBC remains outside domain. Training-unseen Boolean values are separately disclosed in development diagnostics.
baselines: Reuse verified prior joint-cell old-eight/new-eleven forecasts, training prior and constant 0.5; do not refit or retune the baselines
metrics: same-cohort macro Brier and log loss
diagnostic false removal/retention at unchanged 0.5 cutoff
interpretation: Known seven-case development subset, one authored source group; feature design and earlier results already seen. Learning shared weights does not prove causal necessity or calibrated real-world risk.
stop: One fixed additive-model comparison. No lambda sweep, interaction additions, threshold changes, added cases or alternate model after seeing results. Preserve failure or non-improvement.
